movie.title: One Mile: Chapter Two
movie.overview: Former special forces operative Danny is forced back onto a remote island when a violent, secretive community takes revenge by abducting his daughter Alex, launching a relentless hunt against enemies prepared for his every move.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a secretive island community abducts his daughter in revenge, former special forces operative Danny must navigate a deadly hunt against enemies who are prepared for his every move.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In this intense action thriller, former special forces operative Danny is thrust back into danger when a hostile, isolated community seeks vengeance. To save his abducted daughter, Alex, Danny must venture onto a remote island rigged with lethal traps and heavily armed adversaries. With every step calculated by enemies who know his tactics, he is forced to rely on his sharpest combat skills to survive and rescue his child before time runs out.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: After attempting to leave his violent past behind, former special forces operative Danny is forced back into action under tragic circumstances. A secretive and brutal community, harboring a deep grudge against Danny, strikes back by kidnapping his daughter, Alex, and taking her to their fortified remote island. Knowing that Danny will come for her, the community's leaders transform the terrain into a deadly gauntlet specifically designed to counter his tactical knowledge. Unwavering in his determination, Danny launches a high-stakes infiltration mission to rescue Alex against overwhelming odds. As he fights his way through heavily guarded perimeter zones and hostile terrain, he quickly realizes his enemies have anticipated every move in his playbook. With time rapidly slipping away, Danny must adapt his strategies on the fly, pushing his endurance and tactical instinct to their absolute limits. Facing ruthless foes who will stop at nothing to eliminate him, Danny fights through a relentless barrage of confrontations to reach his daughter and bring down the syndicate once and for all.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Former special forces operative Danny seeks a quiet life away from combat, but his past refuses to stay buried. When a violent, secretive community executes a calculated revenge plot by abducting his daughter Alex, Danny is drawn into a desperate rescue mission on an isolated, heavily fortified island. Armed with formidable combat training but facing a enemy force that anticipates his every tactic, Danny must navigate a perilous environment designed to kill him, testing his limits as a soldier and a father in a fight for survival.
